Name: Seasonal Outfits for Abigail Portraits Variant
Author: BladeOfGrass445
Description:
This is a simple mod which hosts seasonal portraits for anime Abigail by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/121177218]CapMita[i].[/i][/url]
I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25768]Abigail Portraits Variant[/url] as a base and added seasonal outfits based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/186676]fifadog[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22876]Anime Seasonal Outfits[/url].

Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/121177218]CapMita[/url] for letting me use their Anime Portrait and multiple thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url] also for the design of the seasonal outfits.
Thanks [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/fifadog]fifadog[/url] for making the Anime Seasonal Portrait.

I do not own the alternative anime portrait of Abigail (credit to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Ohodavi]Ohodavi [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/121177218]CapMita[/url]).
I did not design the outfits (credit to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/fifadog]fifadog[/url]) and the original mod for seasonal outfits: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url].
[size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=4][b]Installation Instructions:[/b][/size]
Move the files to "Seasonal Outfits" assets/Portraits/Abigail, replacing the original portraits.
